_noteP: P (Tailwind): TailwindSelf.BonusDamage (Characters/Janna/Spells/TailwindSelfAbility/TailwindSelf in janna.bin.json) = StatByNamedDataValueCalculationPart(mStat=7, mStatFormula=2, mDataValue=MSBonusMagicDamage=0.30). mStat=7 is confirmed here as Movement Speed (mStatFormula=2 = bonus, same marker AD/Armor/MR already use) -- matches the live tooltip 'deals bonus magic damage equal to 30% of her bonus movement speed' (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Janna, Tailwind). Resolved by SkillDamage.BuildStatResolver's new id-7 mapping to ActivePlayerStats.MoveSpeed minus ChampionBaseStats.Ms. Modeled as a P bonusEffect trigger onHit (same on-next-attack-proc pattern as Leona's Sunlight). Unchanged loop 39.
_noteQ: Q (Howling Gale) charges 0-3s; the prior auto-pick (MinimumDamage = NamedDataValue(MinDamage 20->230)+StatByNamedDataValue(AP ratio MinimumRatio=0.5), i.e. the instant no-charge release) was the FLOOR value, not the representative number. HowlingGaleAbility/HowlingGale also exposes MaxDamage = MinimumDamage-equivalent + ProductOfSubParts(NamedDataValue(MaxDuration=3) x SumOfSubParts(NamedDataValue(BonusDamage 5->35)+StatByNamedDataValue(AP ratio BonusRatio=0.1))) -- both ProductOfSubParts and SumOfSubParts are supported CalculationPart kinds per this engine, so it resolves cleanly. Wiki confirms: base 55/90/125/160/195 (+50%AP) + 10/15/20/25/30 (+10%AP) per extra second charged, fully charged at 3s -- matches MaxDamage exactly. Switched to MaxDamage (fully-charged release), matching this project's established convention for charge-scaling spells (see Nunu.json W/R using Maximum* calcs over floor values). Magic damage confirmed via wiki.
_noteW: W (Zephyr): TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage 25->205) + StatByNamedDataValue(APRatio=0.5). Magic, matches wiki (55/85/115/145/175 +50%AP) exactly. Unchanged, verified correct. Note: wiki also states Zephyr itself procs the Tailwind onHit bonus (already modeled separately under P's bonusEffect) -- not duplicated here to avoid double-counting.
